overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 60.22% annualised against 25.75% volatility (Sharpe 1.79) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. HPE carries the largest weight at 2.9%; SNDK dominates risk contribution at 8.3%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.98% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.70% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.40%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 7.09%, 99% VaR 19.63%, CVaR 95% 14.80%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.90%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-57.29% return, max drawdown -58.05%, worst day -13.39%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 23.65% vs realised 21.59% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: ARE, INTC, MU, SNDK, TWLO, LITE, WDC, STX, TSN, GPN, LEN, EXE, COF have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
